purpose: Let a person, with agents, work across at least three of the five other layers in one session: agent harnesses (Claude Code, Cursor) and custom interfaces (the operator console), all reaching the system through one route table that a CLI, an MCP server and an HTTP API share (EE-030).
gaps: The operator console is a folder, not part of the layer yet
Cannot yet run roles in separate sessions, so one agent can play builder and reviewer
The CLI cannot tell a person from an agent; the pull request a person merges is the gate that holds
The HTTP API has no authentication and binds to 127.0.0.1 only
Views are Markdown; the operator console does not render them yet
Route groups cover phases only; MAD tiers become groups once record types declare a tier
name: interface
